eventMetadata.context_description: Drier Southwest Monsoon conditions and National Environment Agency outlooks projecting daily maxima of 33–34°C have driven trader consensus toward 32°C (68.5% implied probability) and 33°C (30.5%) as the most likely peak temperature in Singapore on August 12. Equatorial humidity, urban heat island effects, and southeasterly flow typically elevate readings above the long-term August average of near 31°C, yet recent model consensus on modest cloud cover and sea-breeze moderation supports the narrow 32–33°C band. Limited convection and forecast uncertainty keep probabilities for 34°C or higher below 2%, consistent with official Meteorological Service Singapore monitoring and historical observations showing similar peaks under comparable monsoon patterns.

eventMetadata.context_description: Forecasts from multiple meteorological agencies, including the Met Office and BBC Weather, indicate peak temperatures in Milan on August 12 will likely reach 34–36°C amid Italy’s fourth summer heatwave, with all major cities under red alert due to persistent high-pressure systems suppressing cloud cover and promoting subsidence warming. This aligns with the market’s leading implied probabilities for 35°C (61.5%) and 36°C (20.5%), as model consensus points to maximums near the upper end of seasonal norms (typical August highs around 28–31°C) while accounting for urban heat island effects in the Po Valley. Recent observational trends show limited overnight cooling and light winds, reducing the chance of significant deviations, though any afternoon convective activity could cap readings at 34°C. Traders appear to weight official guidance on thermal thresholds most heavily, with resolution depending on the highest recorded value at designated stations.

This market will resolve based on the highest temperature recorded in the 'Daily Observations' table on Weather Underground, not the figure displayed in the 'Day High & Low' summary section; in the event of any discrepancy between the two, the Daily Observations table shall be the primary resolution source not the Day High & Low section.

This market will resolve to the temperature range that contains the highest temperature recorded at the Cape Town International Airport Station in degrees Celsius on 14 Aug '26.

The resolution source for this market will be information from Wunderground, specifically the highest temperature recorded for all times on this day for the Cape Town International Airport Station, available here: https://www.wunderground.com/history/daily/za/matroosfontein/FACT.

To toggle between Fahrenheit and Celsius, click the gear icon next to the search bar and switch the Temperature setting between °F and °C.

This market can not resolve until the first data point for the following date has been published on the resolution source.

The resolution source for this market measures temperatures to whole degrees Celsius (eg, 9°C). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.
